name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
May 12, 2015
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 200 Civic Center Drive, Vista, California
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
INVOCATION - Chaplain Linda Gallagher, Rancho Buena Vista Chapter, Daughters of the American Revolution
BROWN ACT NOTICE OF SIMULTANEOUS MEETING COMPENSATION
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Annual Recognition of Adopt-A-Block Groups
P2.
Presentation by a representative from the Del Mar Fairgrounds Marketing Department to promote the 2015 San Diego County Fair.
P3.
Proclamation declaring the week of May 17 to May 23, 2015, to be "Public Works Week," in the City of Vista.
P4.
Proclamation declaring May to be "Bike to Work Month," and Friday, May 15, 2015, to be "National Bike to Work Day" in the City of Vista.
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD/SA)
C3.
Educational Enrichment System (EES) Preschool Special Event Banner (CC)
C4.
2015-2016 Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) Annual Action Plan (CC)
C5.
Establishment of Regular Meeting Dates (JPFA)
C6.
2015-2020 San Diego Regional Analysis of Impediments to Fair Housing Choice (CC)
C7.
Property Assessed Clean Energy Programs (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2015- , authorizing the City to join the CaliforniaFIRST program; authorizing the California Communities Development Authority to accept applications from property owners, conduct contractual assessment proceedings and levy contractual assessments within the incorporated territory of the City; and authorizing related actions;
2.
Resolution No. 2015- , consenting to inclusion of properties within the City's jurisdiction in the California Home Finance Authority Community Facilities District No. 2014-1 (Clean Energy) to finance renewable energy improvements, energy efficiency and water conservation improvements and electric vehicle charging infrastructure and approving associate membership in the joint exercise of powers authority related thereto; and (Recommended Action continued on following page)
3.
Resolution No. 2015- , consenting to inclusion of properties within the City's jurisdiction in the California Home Finance Authority program to finance renewable energy generation, energy and water efficiency improvements and electric vehicle charging infrastructure and approving associate membership in the joint exercise of powers authority related thereto.
C8.
Engineer's Reports and Assessments for Fiscal Year 2015/16 (CC)
1.
Resolution No. 2015- , Landscape and Lighting District No. 1;
2.
Resolution No. 2015- , Street Maintenance District No. 1;
3.
Resolution No. 2015- , South Melrose Landscape Maintenance District; and
4.
Direct staff to set a Public Hearing for June 9, 2015.
C9.
Collection of Delinquent Fiscal Year 2014/15 Property Related Administrative Citations (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , declaring its intent to set a Public Hearing for the collection of delinquent property related administrative citation charges; and
2.
Direct staff to set a Public Hearing for June 9, 2015.
C10.
California Fire Assistance Agreement (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS
PH1.
Appeal of PC14-311, Optimist Club Little League Fields, 600 Optimist Way (CC)
1.
Open, conduct, and close a Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's decision regarding Planning Case No. 14-311, a request for an amendment to the Site Development Plan for the Optimist Club Little League Fields (PC14-170) to modify conditions of approval related to the use of a public address system; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2015- , approving an amendment to the Site Development Plan for the Optimist Club Little League Fields (PC14-170) to modify conditions of approval related to the use of a public address system.
PH2.
Massage Establishment and Massage Therapist Regulations (CC)
1.
Open, conduct and close a Public Hearing to receive testimony regarding the proposed amendment to Development Code Chapter 18.02 concerning Massage Establishments;
2.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2015- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 18.02 of the Vista Development Code to Include a Definition of the Term, Massage Establishment"; and
3.
Introduce and adopt City Council Ordinance No. 2015- , entitled "An Ordinance of the City Council of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 5.56 of the Vista Municipal Code Regarding Massage Establishments and Massage Therapists."
DISCUSSION
D1.
Fiscal Year 2014/15 Third Quarter Financial Report (CC/BSD)
1.
Receive the report.
2.
Adopt the following City Council Resolutions:
a.
Resolution No. 2015- , amending the Operating Budget for FY 2014/15;
b.
Resolution No. 2015- , amending the Capital Improvement Program Budget for FY 2014/15; and
c.
Resolution No. 2015- , amending the City-Wide Classification and Compensation Index.
D2.
Draft Fiscal Year 2015/16 Operating Budget (CC/CDC/SA)
D3.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Update (CC)
D4.
Proposed Downtown Ashcan Project (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
